avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces axitinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases axitinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; use alternative antioxidant if appropriate

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce axitinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; recommend alternative immune support approaches

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses; may increase axitinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; limit to dietary amounts or discuss with oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effects may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases axitinib plasma concentration and toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; switch to alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase axitinib absorption; modest effect on bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take axitinib consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential CYP1A2 competition; unlikely to be clinically significant
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; moderate intake if dizziness or hypertension noted

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly and assess for signs of toxicity (diarrhea, fatigue, hand-foot syndrome) as CYP3A4 interactions significantly affect axitinib exposure. Counsel patients to maintain consistent timing and food intake patterns with each dose to optimize therapeutic levels.
